title: About This Project
intro: TriageFlow is a two-week portfolio project demonstrating full-stack development proficiency with modern tools and AI integration.

who.title: Who Built This
who.body: Built by Piotr Świderski — a full-stack developer exploring the intersection of AI, healthcare simulation, and modern web architecture.

why.title: Why TriageFlow
why.body: The medical triage domain provides rich modeling challenges: state machines, async messaging, AI pipelines, and role-based access control — all in a compact, demonstrable scope.

disclaimer.title: Important Disclaimer
disclaimer.body:
TriageFlow is a demonstration system. It does not provide real medical advice. All triage recommendations are generated by AI for illustrative purposes only.

If you have a medical concern, please consult a qualified healthcare professional.

techDecisions.title: Technical Decisions
techDecisions.architectureDetail: Domain, Application, and Infrastructure layers with Symfony Messenger for async processing and hexagonal ports/adapters pattern.
techDecisions.stateDetail: Server state management with TanStack Query for caching, background refetching, and optimistic updates.
techDecisions.aiDetail: GitHub Copilot powered follow-up questions generation, producing up to 3 turns of interactive triage conversation.
techDecisions.dataDetail: All triage submissions are synthetic, generated by a timed scheduler with realistic typing-speed cooldown simulation.
techDecisions.testingDetail: Test-driven development with PHPUnit, Pest, Vitest, and Playwright. Unit, integration, and E2E coverage targets.
techDecisions.demoDetail: Compact, demonstrable scope — medical triage simulation with AI integration, built as a proof of concept.
